hooks.command: ~/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/gstack-update-check 2>/dev/null; for skill_dir in ~/.claude/skills/gstack/*/; do [ -f "$skill_dir/SKILL.md" ] || continue; skill_name="$(basename "$skill_dir")"; [ "$skill_name" = "node_modules" ] && continue; target="$HOME/.claude/skills/$skill_name"; [ -L "$target" ] || [ ! -e "$target" ] && ln -snf "gstack/$skill_name" "$target" 2>/dev/null || true; done
